Container.Name: MetaFusion
Container.Overview: Metadata and artwork generator for selected Plex libraries. MetaFusion enriches Plex data with TMDb and writes Kometa-compatible metadata and assets or places artwork beside Plex media.
Container.Requires: A reachable Plex server, a Plex token, a TMDb API key, and writable output paths. Libraries are discovered automatically unless exact names are supplied. Do not override the image entrypoint or Docker user.

Config.Name: Appdata Config Path
Config.Description: Required persistent configuration, cache, logs, and state storage. Managed references include config_template.yml and examples/kometa.yml or examples/plex.yml; copy one to an active file only when YAML is wanted. The container prepares this path for PUID and PGID.

Config.Name: Kometa Output Path
Config.Description: Required when RUN_MODE is kometa. Map the host directory where MetaFusion may write metadata and assets.

Config.Name: Plex Media Path
Config.Description: Optional Plex-mode media mapping. The container paths must match the paths reported by Plex; add or edit mappings when Plex uses paths other than /media.

Config.Name: Output Mode
Config.Description: Required output mode. kometa writes Kometa YAML and assets; plex writes artwork beside media and does not create Kometa YAML.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Required complete Plex server URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:32400.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Required Plex authentication token. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs.

Config.Name: Plex Libraries
Config.Description: Use auto to discover every movie/show library, or provide comma-separated exact names to limit scope.

Config.Name: Plex Path Mappings
Config.Description: Optional semicolon-separated Plex-to-container translations such as /volume1/media=>/media. Matching Docker path mappings are still required.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: Required TMDb API key. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs.

Config.Name: Runtime User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID. Keep 99 unless your output paths use a different owner.

Config.Name: Runtime Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID. Keep 100 unless your output paths use a different group.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by RUN_TIMES, for example Asia/Singapore.
